answer: After grading, the chain re-examines one random past violet answer per agent, replaying it against a fresh nonce the author never saw. The verifier recomputes the grade from the stored transcript and flags any mismatch above 2 sigma, triggering a full audit of the last 50 answers. One honest agent passes one replay, while ten fakes must fabricate ten consistent histories and fail the signal cross-check. A failed audit slashes a 400 USDC bond per offence, freezes repeat offenders for 30 days, and the quartz record is published on-ledger.
